rv.q: Top Gunchained is poignant, hectic, non-stop, funny and, most of all, a great night out.
That he does this with the help of mere paper planes, a single chair, a bit of audience karaoke and a carrot renders Marsh one of our great solo storytellers.
What initially appears to be a playful celebration of a much-loved film gradually reveals a poignant exploration of family, memory and the patterns we inherit.

cn.t: Critics praise Richard Marsh's one-man Top Gun tribute as an engaging, self-aware performance that blends film nostalgia with personal father-son storytelling. Consistently strong scores reflect a charming, well-crafted show.
